data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER tags_immutable_identity
AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, id ON tags
WHEN
  new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR
  new.id <> old.id
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag identity is immutable');
END;

data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_valid_tag_order_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON tag_assignments
WHEN
  (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id) IS NULL OR
  (new.tag_creation_sequence <> 0 AND
   new.tag_creation_sequence <> (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag assignment order does not match tag');
END;

data.name: tag_assignments_fill_tag_order
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_fill_tag_order
AFTER INSERT ON tag_assignments
WHEN new.tag_creation_sequence = 0
BEGIN
  UPDATE tag_assignments
  SET tag_creation_sequence = (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id)
  WHERE creation_sequence = new.creation_sequence;
END;

data.name: tag_assignments_valid_tag_order_update
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_valid_tag_order_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON tag_assignments
WHEN
  new.tag_creation_sequence IS NOT (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id) OR
  (old.tag_creation_sequence <> 0 AND
   new.tag_creation_sequence <> old.tag_creation_sequence)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag assignment order is immutable');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_protect_daily_choice_path
BEFORE UPDATE OF type, source_intention_id, related_intention_id
ON long_term_relations
WHEN
  (
    new.type <> old.type OR
    new.source_intention_id <> old.source_intention_id OR
    new.related_intention_id <> old.related_intention_id
  ) AND
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM daily_choice_path_steps
    WHERE long_term_relation_id = old.id
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'long-term relation is used by a daily choice path');
END;

data.name: long_term_relations_active_participants_after_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_insert
AFTER INSERT ON long_term_relations
WHEN
  new.is_archived = 0 AND
  (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    ) OR
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');
END;

data.name: long_term_relations_active_participants_after_update

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_update
AFTER UPDATE OF source_intention_id, related_intention_id, is_archived
ON long_term_relations
WHEN
  new.is_archived = 0 AND
  (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    ) OR
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');
END;

data.name: intentions_archive_requires_no_active_relations
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER intentions_archive_requires_no_active_relations
AFTER UPDATE OF is_archived ON intentions
WHEN
  old.is_archived = 0 AND
  new.is_archived = 1 AND
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM long_term_relations
    WHERE
      is_archived = 0 AND
      (
        source_intention_id = new.id OR
        related_intention_id = new.id
      )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active relations must be archived first');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_control" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "capture" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(capture) = 'integer' AND capture IN (0, 1)), "writing" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(writing) = 'integer' AND writing IN (0, 1)));
INSERT INTO graph_log_control (id, capture, writing) VALUES (1, 1, 0)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_tag_marks" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "first_operation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_operation IN ('insert', 'update', 'delete')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_intention_marks" ("intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "first_operation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_operation IN ('insert', 'update', 'delete')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_tag_assignment_marks" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_operation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_operation IN ('insert', 'update', 'delete')), PRIMARY KEY(tag_id, intention_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_long_term_relation_marks" ("long_term_relation_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "first_operation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_operation IN ('insert', 'update', 'delete')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_daily_choice_marks" ("daily_choice_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "first_operation" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_operation IN ('insert', 'update', 'delete')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_snapshots" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (id > 0), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0), "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (typeof(file_name) = 'text' AND file_name <> ''), "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(byte_size) = 'integer' AND byte_size > 0), "checksum" BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(checksum) = 'blob' AND length(checksum) = 32));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_log_packages" ("position" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (position > 0), "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(recorded_at) = 'integer'), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(kind) = 'text' AND kind IN ('change', 'reset')), "format_version" INTEGER CHECK (format_version IS NULL OR(typeof(format_version) = 'integer' AND format_version > 0)), "facts" BLOB CHECK (facts IS NULL OR typeof(facts) = 'blob'), "snapshot_id" INTEGER REFERENCES graph_snapshots(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK((kind = 'change' AND format_version IS NOT NULL AND facts IS NOT NULL AND snapshot_id IS NULL)OR(kind = 'reset' AND format_version IS NULL AND facts IS NULL AND snapshot_id IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_backups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (id > 0), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(kind) = 'text' AND kind IN ('daily', 'manual', 'before_replacement')), "made_at" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(made_at) = 'integer'), "graph_replaced" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(graph_replaced) = 'integer' AND graph_replaced IN (0, 1)), "added_count" INTEGER CHECK (added_count IS NULL OR(typeof(added_count) = 'integer' AND added_count >= 0)), "changed_count" INTEGER CHECK (changed_count IS NULL OR(typeof(changed_count) = 'integer' AND changed_count >= 0)), "deleted_count" INTEGER CHECK (deleted_count IS NULL OR(typeof(deleted_count) = 'integer' AND deleted_count >= 0)), CHECK((graph_replaced = 0 AND added_count IS NOT NULL AND changed_count IS NOT NULL AND deleted_count IS NOT NULL)OR(graph_replaced = 1 AND added_count IS NULL AND changed_count IS NULL AND deleted_count IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (creation_sequence > 0), "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(name) = 'text' AND instr(CAST(name AS BLOB), X'00') = 0 AND substr(name, 1, 1) <> char(65279) AND doable_tag_name_valid_v1(name) = 1), "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY UNIQUE GENERATED ALWAYS AS (doable_tag_name_key_v1(name)) STORED);

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_tag_insert AFTER INSERT ON tags WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_tag_marks (tag_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'insert');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_tag_update AFTER UPDATE ON tags WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_tag_marks (tag_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_tag_delete AFTER DELETE ON tags WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_tag_marks (tag_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.id, 'delete');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intentions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (title <> '' AND instr(CAST(title AS BLOB), X'00') = 0), "title_search_key" TEXT NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (doable_title_search_key(title)) STORED CHECK (title_search_key <> '' AND instr(CAST(title_search_key AS BLOB), X'00') = 0), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR(instr(CAST(description AS BLOB), X'00') = 0 AND length(trim(description, char(9) || char(10) || char(11) || char(12) || char(13) || char(32))) > 0)), "is_action_ready" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_action_ready IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_intention_insert AFTER INSERT ON intentions WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_intention_marks (intention_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'insert');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_intention_update AFTER UPDATE ON intentions WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_intention_marks (intention_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_intention_delete AFTER DELETE ON intentions WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_intention_marks (intention_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.id, 'delete');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag_assignments" ("creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (creation_sequence > 0), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tag_creation_sequence >= 0), "intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE(tag_id, intention_id));

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_tag_assignment_insert AFTER INSERT ON tag_assignments WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_tag_assignment_marks (tag_id, intention_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.tag_id, new.intention_id, 'insert');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_tag_assignment_update AFTER UPDATE ON tag_assignments WHEN old.tag_creation_sequence <> 0 AND (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_tag_assignment_marks (tag_id, intention_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.tag_id, new.intention_id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_tag_assignment_delete AFTER DELETE ON tag_assignments WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_tag_assignment_marks (tag_id, intention_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.tag_id, old.intention_id, 'delete');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "long_term_relations" ("creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (creation_sequence > 0), "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "related_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(type) = 'text' AND type IN ('need', 'can')), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(priority) = 'integer' AND priority BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR(typeof(description) = 'text' AND instr(CAST(description AS BLOB), X'00') = 0)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (typeof(is_archived) = 'integer' AND is_archived IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE(source_intention_id, related_intention_id), CHECK(source_intention_id <> related_intention_id));

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_long_term_relation_insert AFTER INSERT ON long_term_relations WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_long_term_relation_marks (long_term_relation_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'insert');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_long_term_relation_update AFTER UPDATE ON long_term_relations WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_long_term_relation_marks (long_term_relation_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_long_term_relation_delete AFTER DELETE ON long_term_relations WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_long_term_relation_marks (long_term_relation_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.id, 'delete');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_choices" ("creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (creation_sequence > 0), "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "selected_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "choice_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(choice_date) = 'text' AND length(choice_date) = 10 AND choice_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR(typeof(description) = 'text' AND instr(CAST(description AS BLOB), X'00') = 0)), "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(is_completed) = 'integer' AND is_completed IN (0, 1)), "scheduled_minute" INTEGER CHECK (scheduled_minute IS NULL OR(typeof(scheduled_minute) = 'integer' AND scheduled_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4 CHECK (typeof(priority) = 'integer' AND priority BETWEEN 1 AND 4), CHECK(source_intention_id <> selected_intention_id));

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_daily_choice_insert AFTER INSERT ON daily_choices WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_daily_choice_marks (daily_choice_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'insert');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_daily_choice_update AFTER UPDATE ON daily_choices WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_daily_choice_marks (daily_choice_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_daily_choice_delete AFTER DELETE ON daily_choices WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_daily_choice_marks (daily_choice_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.id, 'delete');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_choice_path_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "daily_choice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_choices(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE, "long_term_relation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES long_term_relations(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "previous_step_id" TEXT, UNIQUE(daily_choice_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(daily_choice_id, previous_step_id)REFERENCES daily_choice_path_steps(daily_choice_id, id)ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CHECK(previous_step_id IS NULL OR previous_step_id <> id));

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_daily_choice_path_step_insert AFTER INSERT ON daily_choice_path_steps WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_daily_choice_marks (daily_choice_id, first_operation) VALUES (new.daily_choice_id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_daily_choice_path_step_update AFTER UPDATE ON daily_choice_path_steps WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_daily_choice_marks (daily_choice_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.daily_choice_id, 'update'), (new.daily_choice_id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER graph_log_mark_daily_choice_path_step_delete AFTER DELETE ON daily_choice_path_steps WHEN (SELECT capture FROM graph_log_control) = 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'graph write outside the graph write path') FROM graph_log_control WHERE writing = 0;INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_log_daily_choice_marks (daily_choice_id, first_operation) VALUES (old.daily_choice_id, 'update');END

CREATE TRIGGER tags_immutable_identity AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, id ON tags WHEN new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR new.id <> old.id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'tag identity is immutable');END
CREATE INDEX tag_assignments_tag_order ON tag_assignments (tag_id, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX tag_assignments_intention ON tag_assignments (intention_id, tag_id)
CREATE INDEX tag_assignments_intention_order ON tag_assignments (intention_id, tag_creation_sequence)

CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_valid_tag_order_insert BEFORE INSERT ON tag_assignments WHEN (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id) IS NULL OR(new.tag_creation_sequence <> 0 AND new.tag_creation_sequence <> (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'tag assignment order does not match tag');END

CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_fill_tag_order AFTER INSERT ON tag_assignments WHEN new.tag_creation_sequence = 0 BEGIN UPDATE tag_assignments SET tag_creation_sequence = (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id) WHERE creation_sequence = new.creation_sequence;END

CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_valid_tag_order_update BEFORE UPDATE ON tag_assignments WHEN new.tag_creation_sequence IS NOT (SELECT creation_sequence FROM tags WHERE id = new.tag_id) OR(old.tag_creation_sequence <> 0 AND new.tag_creation_sequence <> old.tag_creation_sequence)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'tag assignment order is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER tag_assignments_immutable_identity AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, tag_id, intention_id ON tag_assignments WHEN new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR new.tag_id <> old.tag_id OR new.intention_id <> old.intention_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'tag assignment identity is immutable');END
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_date_completion_schedule_order ON daily_choices (choice_date, is_completed, COALESCE(scheduled_minute, -1), priority, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_date_creation_order ON daily_choices (choice_date, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_source_date_creation_order ON daily_choices (source_intention_id, choice_date, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_selected_date_creation_order ON daily_choices (selected_intention_id, choice_date, creation_sequence)

CREATE TRIGGER daily_choices_immutable_identity AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, id ON daily_choices WHEN new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR new.id <> old.id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'daily choice identity is immutable');END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_choice_path_steps_one_root ON daily_choice_path_steps (daily_choice_id) WHERE previous_step_id IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_choice_path_steps_one_successor ON daily_choice_path_steps (daily_choice_id, previous_step_id) WHERE previous_step_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX daily_choice_path_steps_relation ON daily_choice_path_steps (long_term_relation_id)

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_protect_daily_choice_path BEFORE UPDATE OF type, source_intention_id, related_intention_id ON long_term_relations WHEN(new.type <> old.type OR new.source_intention_id <> old.source_intention_id OR new.related_intention_id <> old.related_intention_id)AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_choice_path_steps WHERE long_term_relation_id = old.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'long-term relation is used by a daily choice path');END
CREATE INDEX long_term_relations_source_group_order ON long_term_relations (source_intention_id, type, is_archived, priority, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX long_term_relations_related_group_order ON long_term_relations (related_intention_id, type, is_archived, priority, creation_sequence)

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_immutable_identity AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, id ON long_term_relations WHEN new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR new.id <> old.id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'long-term relation identity is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON long_term_relations WHEN new.is_archived = 0 AND(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');END

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_update AFTER UPDATE OF source_intention_id, related_intention_id, is_archived ON long_term_relations WHEN new.is_archived = 0 AND(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');END

CREATE TRIGGER intentions_archive_requires_no_active_relations AFTER UPDATE OF is_archived ON intentions WHEN old.is_archived = 0 AND new.is_archived = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_term_relations WHERE is_archived = 0 AND(source_intention_id = new.id OR related_intention_id = new.id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'active relations must be archived first');END
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intention_titles_fts" USING fts5(title_search_key, content = 'intentions', content_rowid = 'rowid', tokenize = 'trigram case_sensitive 0 remove_diacritics 0');
CREATE TRIGGER intentions_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON intentions BEGIN INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts ("rowid", title_search_key) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title_search_key);END

CREATE TRIGGER intentions_fts_after_update_search_content AFTER UPDATE ON intentions BEGIN INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts (intention_titles_fts, "rowid", title_search_key) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title_search_key);INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts ("rowid", title_search_key) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title_search_key);END

CREATE TRIGGER intentions_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON intentions BEGIN INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts (intention_titles_fts, "rowid", title_search_key) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title_search_key);END
